area_food_guide.title: Rajendra Nagar & Karol Bagh Food Hub
area_food_guide.vibe_badge: High-octane civil services study hub meets heritage Punjabi food culture, packed with budget student thalis and late-night cutting chai addas.
area_food_guide.famous_for_summary: Signature Desi Ghee Chole Bhature, Unlimited Regional Vegetarian Thalis (Rajasthani, Gujarati & Punjabi), Crisp South Indian Dosas & Filter Coffee, and Piping-Hot Tandoori Kulhad Chai.
area_food_guide.best_time_to_visit: 1:00 PM – 3:30 PM (Peak student thali lunch hour) & 6:00 PM – 10:30 PM (Evening street eats, tea discussions & dinner buzz)
area_food_guide.nearest_metro: Karol Bagh Metro Station (Blue Line, Gate 4) & Rajendra Place Metro Station (Blue Line, Gate 2)
area_food_guide.parking_tips: Bada Bazar Road and Ajmal Khan Road are heavily congested pedestrian zones with zero curbside parking; park strictly at the Karol Bagh Multilevel Car Parking on Gurudwara Road or use Delhi Metro.

famous_dishes.name: Kesar Pista Kulfi Falooda
famous_dishes.why_famous: Hand-churned dense malai kulfi infused with saffron and pistachios, topped with silky hand-pressed cornstarch falooda and fragrant rose syrup since 1956.

famous_dishes.name: Unlimited Royal Gujarati & Rajasthani Thali
famous_dishes.why_famous: Grand brass plate feast featuring 4 seasonal sabzis, Dal Baati Churma, sweet Gujarati Kadhi, steamed Dhokla, Phulkas with white butter, and Malpua.

famous_dishes.name: Ghee Podi Masala Dosa
famous_dishes.why_famous: Stone-ground fermented crepe roasted crisp in pure A2 ghee, generously dusted with fiery Gunpowder chutney podi, served with three fresh chutneys.

famous_dishes.name: Special Amritsari Paneer Chur Chur Naan Thali
famous_dishes.why_famous: Tandoor-blistered, heavily butter-crushed paneer kulcha served with slow-cooked pindi chole, boondi raita, and pickled onions.

famous_dishes.name: Special Methi Chole Bhature
famous_dishes.why_famous: Spiced chickpeas slow-simmered in an iron kadhai with whole dried gooseberries (amla) and topped with tangy fenugreek chutney and paneer-stuffed bhature.

food_crawl_stops.recommended_dish: Ghee Butter Masala Dosa & Degree Filter Coffee
food_crawl_stops.note: Fuel up before study breaks end and evening crowds take over Bada Bazar Road.

food_crawl_stops.type: Hearty Main Dinner / Royal Vegetarian Thali
food_crawl_stops.venue_name: Temple Street – South Indian & Multi Cuisine Restaurant
food_crawl_stops.recommended_dish: Special Maharaja North Indian Thali with Dal Makhani & Shahi Paneer
food_crawl_stops.note: Spacious fully air-conditioned dine-in hall with fast service and comfortable seating.

food_crawl_stops.distance_to_next: End of Crawl (Adjacent to Karol Bagh Metro Gate 1)
food_crawl_stops.note: The quintessential post-dinner sweet ritual of Central Delhi since 1956.

venues.name: Temple Street – South Indian & Multi Cuisine Restaurant
venues.short_description: Vibrant, pure vegetarian culinary anchor of Old Rajinder Nagar known for authentic dosas and student thalis.
venues.long_description: Spanning a spacious, fully air-conditioned dining hall on Bada Bazar Road, Temple Street is the undisputed gathering ground for civil services aspirants and visiting families. The kitchen operates with strict satvik purity, churning out crisp ghee-roasted dosas, rich paneer curries, and generous multi-course student thalis.
venues.address_line1: 16-B, Ground Floor, National Trust Building, Bada Bazar Road

items.name: Mysore Masala Dosa
items.description: Crisp golden rice crepe layered with spicy red garlic-chili paste and stuffed with seasoned potato mash, served with sambar and fresh coconut chutneys.

items.name: Steamed Idli Platter (2 Pcs)
items.description: Fluffy, fermented rice cakes dipped in piping hot vegetable sambar with coconut and tomato-onion chutneys.

items.name: Temple Street Executive Thali
items.description: Dal Makhani, Shahi Paneer, Mix Veg, Steamed Rice, 2 Butter Roti, 1 Laccha Paratha, Boondi Raita, Salad, and Gulab Jamun.

items.name: Paneer Lababdar
items.description: Cubes of fresh cottage cheese simmered in a luscious onion-tomato gravy with cream and grated paneer.

venues.name: Suruchi Restaurant
venues.short_description: Legendary destination in Karol Bagh celebrated for its unlimited traditional Gujarati and Rajasthani royal thalis.
venues.long_description: Stepping into Suruchi on Saraswati Marg feels like arriving at a festive royal banquet. Renowned for decades as Karol Bagh's premier pure vegetarian haven, the restaurant features attentive hospitality where servers continuously replenish brass platters. Families and students rewarding themselves after grueling exams flock here for genuine regional flavors, warm phulkas served with homemade white butter, and rotating festive sweets.

items.name: Unlimited Gujarati & Rajasthani Grand Thali
items.description: Unlimited feast with 4 vegetables, Dal Baati Churma, sweet Gujarati Kadhi, Rajasthani Panchmel Dal, Farsan, Phulkas, Puri, Khichdi, Rice, and Sweets.

items.name: Kesar Rabdi Malpua (2 Pcs)
items.description: Deep-fried traditional sweet pancakes soaked in saffron sugar syrup and smothered in thick chilled cardamom rabdi.

venues.name: Roshan Di Kulfi
venues.short_description: Legendary 1950s Ajmal Khan Road institution renowned for iconic Chole Bhature and rich Kesar Pista Kulfi Falooda.
venues.long_description: No gastronomic expedition to Karol Bagh is complete without visiting Roshan Di Kulfi. Established in the post-partition era, this multi-floor air-conditioned eatery boasts a vibrant Punjabi spirit. Patrons wait patiently for their golden, puffed bhatures served with dark, spiced pindi chole and tangy carrot pickles, followed universally by their world-famous falooda-draped kulfi.
venues.landmark: Near Karol Bagh Metro Station Gate 1

items.name: Special Desi Ghee Chole Bhature
items.description: Two crispy, fluffy bhature served with signature dark masala pindi chole, mint-coriander chutney, and house pickled carrots and green chilies.

items.name: Special Kesar Pista Kulfi Falooda
items.description: Dense hand-churned saffron and pistachio kulfi slab served on a bed of chilled starch falooda noodles and drizzled with rose roohafza.

venues.name: Padmanabham
venues.short_description: Regal pure vegetarian temple-inspired fine casual dining at Rajendra Place celebrating the cuisines of Andhra, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Karnataka.
venues.long_description: Adorned with hand-painted temple murals, brass bell chandeliers, and traditional Chettinad wooden woodwork, Padmanabham offers a royal South Indian dining sanctuary right at Rajendra Place. UPSC toppers and office executives alike occupy its plush booths to relish multi-course banana leaf thalis and artisan ghee dosas prepared by native coastal chefs with stone-ground batters.
venues.address_line1: Upper Ground Floor, District Centre, HOG Market, T Sohanlal Marg

items.name: Ghee Podi Masala Dosa
items.description: Paper-crisp dosa roasted in pure desi ghee, layered with spicy roasted lentil podi and stuffed with turmeric potato bhaji.

items.name: Dakshin Royal Bhojanam Thali
items.description: Elaborate multi-course platter with Rice, Poori, Sambar, Rasam, Avial, Kootu, Poriyal, Curd, Appalam, Pickle, and Payasam.

venues.name: Amritsari Kulcha King
venues.short_description: Authentic Punjabi dining restaurant in Old Rajinder Nagar Market famed for crisp chur-chur stuffed kulchas and creamy lassi.
venues.long_description: Bringing the true culinary traditions of Amritsar to Central Delhi, Amritsari Kulcha King in Old Rajinder Nagar Market is famous for its crisp, multilayered tandoori kulchas. Each kulcha is baked golden in a fiery clay tandoor, crushed aggressively with Amul butter, and served alongside slow-simmered pindi chole and tangy onion chutney in an air-conditioned dining setup.

items.name: Special Amritsari Paneer Pyaaz Kulcha Thali
items.description: Multi-layered tandoori kulcha stuffed with spiced cottage cheese and onions, crushed with Amul butter, served with pindi chole, boondi raita, and onion chutney.

items.name: Special Amritsari Sweet Pedha Lassi
items.description: Thick curd lassi churned with traditional pedha sweet and topped with a heavy layer of malai.

venues.name: Om Corner
venues.short_description: World-famous Sant Nagar Chole Bhature institution featuring sit-down dining hall, signature methi chutney, and sweet lassi.
venues.long_description: Operating since 1974 at Sant Nagar Chowk on DB Gupta Road in Karol Bagh, Om Corner is one of Delhi's most celebrated vegetarian culinary landmarks. Unlike street stalls, it provides an organized, air-conditioned indoor dining area where thousands enjoy their unique Chole Bhature. The chole are simmered with whole spices and topped with a distinctive, tangy fenugreek seed (methi) chutney.
venues.landmark: Near Dev Nagar Chowk / DB Gupta Road

items.name: Om Corner Special Chole Bhature
items.description: Two freshly fried golden bhature stuffed with paneer slivers, served with dark spiced chole, signature tangy methi chutney, and pickled amla.

items.name: Special Kesar Pista Sweet Lassi
items.description: Creamy thick yogurt drink topped with clotted malai, saffron syrup, and slivered pistachios.
